description: This file is a shell script that runs a suite of performance-related tests for the perf-lib facilities. It sources 'perf-lib.sh' for library functions and performs a series of test functions like 'test_perf', 'test_export', and 'test_expect_success', primarily focused on verifying the correctness and behavior of perf-lib components.

methods.name: test_perf
methods.description: Runs a performance test with a descriptive message and associated command.

methods.name: test_export
methods.description: Exports a variable to the environment for the test scope.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test that expects success with a given description.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test suite.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks if a given path is a file.
